delivery.en: Leave it at the door or with a neighbour, or collect from the Syrian post or a courier office
delivery.zh: 放門口或交鄰居，或到敘利亞郵局、快遞點領取

readback.en: 09 mobiles go in short groups; 12-hour times; amounts in Syrian pounds
readback.zh: 09 手機分短組唸；時間用 12 小時制；金額用敘利亞鎊

fraud.en: A fake post, telecom or bank OTP request, or a parcel fee, is a scam
fraud.zh: 冒充郵局、電信或銀行要驗證碼，或假包裹補費的都是詐騙

habits.en: Syrian Arabic; formal titles with strangers and brief courtesy. Do not use CliQ, Whish or Qi Card.
habits.zh: 用敘利亞阿拉伯語，對陌生人用敬稱，客套要短。不要套用 CliQ、Whish、Qi Card。

stall_local.en: Get stuck on a power cut freezing an app, an SMS code that never arrives, or missing glasses.
stall_local.zh: 卡在停電讓 App 卡住、簡訊碼沒到、找不到眼鏡。

talk_style_diff.en: Stay in Syrian Arabic. Keep formal address with strangers and brief blessings; drop other-country payment brands.
talk_style_diff.zh: 用敘利亞阿拉伯語。對陌生人保持正式、祝福要短；不用其他國家的支付品牌。

uncertain: 本地常用電子錢包名稱此次未找到足夠穩妥、可單獨引用的官方清單，故銀行詞彙只用通用說法。
郵局與電信防詐通告有，但日常取件習慣的細項資料較少。
投遞欄改寫為點出敘利亞郵局；日常取件細項仍偏少，見既有 uncertain。
